variables.name: customer_message
variables.purpose: The customer message to answer, exactly as the customer wrote it. Untrusted text.
variables.sample: Hi, where is my order ORD-10423? It was supposed to arrive this week.

variables.name: company_name
variables.purpose: The shop name the assistant speaks for. Set once per deployment, not per request.

tools.name: lookup_order
tools.description: Look up one order by its ID. Returns status (processing, shipped, delayed, delivered or not_found), carrier, tracking number and dates.

order_id.description: The order ID from the customer message, for example ORD-10423.
